description: Provider model IDs the token-budget ledger may settle. Exact string match only: no prefix, alias or future-build matching. The ledger valuation assumes a 1x multiplier, so every entry must have multiplier 1. New dated builds are added by scripts/jev-model-check.mjs --update only when the public docs give the exact dated ID and its multiplier; evidence_sha256 is the sha256 of the saved docs bytes. Seed entries predate saved evidence files, so their evidence_sha256 is null and evidence_note keeps the original verification record.
